body_long:
Albin Chavy has joined Rosewood Hotel Group at its Hong Kong headquarters as Global Director, Operational Planning. In this role he covers planning for both new and existing hotels across the group's portfolio.

He arrives after more than seven years at Compass Group, the global food and support services company, where he was latterly Regional Director, Business Excellence, Asia-Pacific.

## Building the operating platform

The appointment comes as Rosewood strengthens its corporate team. In October the group also named Sam Cooper Vice President, Wellness, Global, Gaye Gibson Vice President, Retail and Partnerships, Global, and Friedrich von Schönburg Vice President, Operations, Asia-Pacific and Operations Excellence, Global. Those appointments extend the reorganisation led by Anthony Ingham, chief operating officer since September 2025.

Rosewood Hotel Group manages more than 50 properties in 25 countries and territories, with more than 30 projects in development. Shenzhen is expected at the end of 2026, followed by Milan, Rome, Mexico and Crete in 2027.

## The signal

With more than 30 hotels in the pipeline, operational planning becomes a strategic function: staffing models, budgets and pre-opening schedules have to be set long before a hotel welcomes its first guest. Bringing in a profile from business excellence at a global services company shows that luxury groups are borrowing method from other industries to scale without losing quality.

Congratulations to Albin Chavy on his new role.
